Build a prediction cohort: prepubertal features and a late outcome

Source: R/pred.R
wgh_prediction_cohort.Rd

Reproduces the cohort construction of the late-adolescent height prediction study (Ho 2026, manuscript under review). For each child it takes the earliest visit at or before a sex-specific prepubertal cutoff as the baseline, derives growth features from all prepubertal visits, and links the median height in a sex-specific late-adolescent outcome window. A temporal check confirms that every baseline precedes the outcome window. Generalises build_growth_features() from Book 1 Chapter 10.

Usage

wgh_prediction_cohort(
  x,
  cutoff = c(Male = 11, Female = 9),
  outcome_window = list(Male = c(16, 18), Female = c(14, 16)),
  sitar_effects = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Growth data with haz and baz.

cutoff

Named vector of the latest baseline age by sex (whole years, as in the late-adolescent height prediction study (Ho 2026, manuscript under review), so 11 means up to 11.999 years).

outcome_window

Named list of outcome age windows by sex.

sitar_effects

Optional output of wgh_sitar_effects().

Value

A tibble with one row per child, the outcome height_late, and an attribute "attrition".

Details

Features: baseline height, HAZ, BAZ, height-for-age and BMI categories; short-term velocity (first two prepubertal visits 0.4 to 3 years apart), long-term velocity (first to last prepubertal visit); BAZ and HAZ slopes per year; a three-level BMI trajectory; birth year. Optional SITAR timing and intensity (b, c) are joined when sitar_effects is supplied. SITAR size (a) is never joined, because it is estimated from the outcome-window visits.

Examples

# \donttest{
pc <- wgh_prediction_cohort(growdat)
table(pc$sex)
#> 
#>   Male Female 
#>     40     39 
attr(pc, "attrition")
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   step                         children   pct
#>   <chr>                           <int> <dbl>
#> 1 All children                     3259  NA  
#> 2 With a prepubertal visit         2281  NA  
#> 3 With an outcome-window visit       79  NA  
#> 4 Retained, Site1                    NA   2.3
#> 5 Retained, Site2                    NA   3.1
#> 6 Retained, Site3                    NA   1.7
# }
